## Checklist

- [ ] Every new number and command comes from an official Sangria Falls source (and the page lists it in `sources`)
- [ ] Unconfirmed claims use `<Unverified q="Q-xxx">` and the page has the `verify` label
- [ ] Commands are copied exactly, not translated
- [ ] `docs/coverage.yaml` updated (then `npm run coverage`)
- [ ] `npm run check`, `npm test` and `npm run build` pass
- [ ] `npm run audit` passes (needs `npm run research` first), or the new calculated numbers are in `docs/audit-allowlist.yaml` with their formula
